jobs.description_text: Ready to build what's next? #JoinTheBand What We Are Looking For: Bandwidth is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to drive net new logo acquisition across complex, high-value enterprise accounts. This is a hunter role at its core - built for someone who thrives on originating and closing six- and seven-figure ARR deals in competitive, technically sophisticated markets. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description_text: As the Principal Product Manager, Network Economics at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. BetterHelp is looking for a principal-level individual contributor to own therapist compensation and incentives: the economic mechanisms that determine whether a client who needs care can find the right therapist, in their state, under their plan, as soon as possible. We match hundreds of thousands of clients to licensed therapists across every state and a growing set of insurance plans. How quickly that match happens comes down to the strength, size, and variety of our therapist population, and how quickly we can shift it toward the plans and states where clients are waiting. This individual will own the mechanisms that drive that supply pool, compensation rates, structure, and incentives, as a product and be accountable for the business outcome, not just the shipped feature. That means close collaboration with cross functional stakeholders, deriving defensible answers to how much therapist capacity we actually need and where, and experiments that tell us how the network responds when we change what it earns. jobs.description_text: If you are looking to join a small, dynamic, growing firm in the financial technology sector, you have come to the right place. BlackEdge has built a strong foundation of success as an industry leading market maker in the treasury options space. Now we need talented people like you to build on that foundation by further improving and leveraging our existing success to expand into new markets. The Role: We’re seeking a Quantitative Researcher to tackle challenging, longer-term problems that drive our trading strategies forward. Unlike the fast-paced, short-cycle puzzles solved by our quantitative traders, you’ll dive into ambiguous problems that require deep mathematical intuition, independent research, and creative model development. Develop robust, data-driven models that balance theoretical rigor with practical application, using mathematical and statistical techniques. jobs.description_text: Antenna Associate (Summer 2027) Internships at Astranis typically last for twelve weeks, and are hourly roles designed for students who are currently enrolled at a four-year university.
